spans.text: What happens when the Sector's fully repaired?

units.rawText: [＞﹏＜Oh no! The sector will be fully repaired one day. Then, we'll be lazy slobs, doing the same things over and over again.]
units.displayText: [＞﹏＜Oh no! The sector will be fully repaired one day. Then, we'll be lazy slobs, doing the same things over and over again.]

units.rawText: [(ﾉ´д｀) We'll have no work again. We'll be lazy slobs, with no rights to chocolate.]
units.displayText: [(ﾉ´д｀) We'll have no work again. We'll be lazy slobs, with no rights to chocolate.]

spans.text: [(ﾉ´д｀) We'll have no work again. We'll be lazy slobs, with no rights to chocolate.]

units.rawText: That familiar flavor of pensiveness proliferates again. Penumbra feels something in his head whirring, the stress on his neural cloud is greater than back inside the reactor.
units.displayText: That familiar flavor of pensiveness proliferates again. Penumbra feels something in his head whirring, the stress on his neural cloud is greater than back inside the reactor.

spans.text: That familiar flavor of pensiveness proliferates again. Penumbra feels something in his head whirring, the stress on his neural cloud is greater than back inside the reactor.

units.rawText: Penumbra finds himself in the same situation, and Uranus comes to the rescue once again.
units.displayText: Penumbra finds himself in the same situation, and Uranus comes to the rescue once again.

spans.text: Penumbra finds himself in the same situation, and Uranus comes to the rescue once again.

units.rawText: Zzp... please leave it to me, Mr. Penumbra.
units.displayText: Zzp... please leave it to me, Mr. Penumbra.

spans.text: Zzp... please leave it to me, Mr. Penumbra.

units.rawText: Beeeep... let us set off for Choco's Chocolaterie. We have left Choco waiting for some time now, and the repairs ought to begin.
units.displayText: Beeeep... let us set off for Choco's Chocolaterie. We have left Choco waiting for some time now, and the repairs ought to begin.

spans.text: Penumbra lets out a hefty sigh of relief as Uranus bails him out.

units.rawText: With Uranus' words, the three little robots set off towards the Chocolaterie, not a hint of sorrow to be seen.
units.displayText: With Uranus' words, the three little robots set off towards the Chocolaterie, not a hint of sorrow to be seen.

spans.text: With Uranus' words, the three little robots set off towards the Chocolaterie, not a hint of sorrow to be seen.

units.rawText: Phew... it's almost like there's a switch for their emotions.
units.displayText: Phew... it's almost like there's a switch for their emotions.

spans.text: Phew... it's almost like there's a switch for their emotions.

units.rawText: And you are the one who accidentally flips the switch off, right? Zzp... actually, it's quite simple to make them happy.
units.displayText: And you are the one who accidentally flips the switch off, right? Zzp... actually, it's quite simple to make them happy.

spans.text: And you are the one who accidentally flips the switch off, right? Zzp... actually, it's quite simple to make them happy.

units.rawText: Umm... what's the key?
units.displayText: Umm... what's the key?

spans.text: Umm... what's the key?

units.rawText: Tell them that there are things they are yet to do, duties they are yet to complete.
units.displayText: Tell them that there are things they are yet to do, duties they are yet to complete.

spans.text: Tell them that there are things they are yet to do, duties they are yet to complete.

units.rawText: Uranus turns to Penumbra, his ever-so-static countenance making his tone indistinguishable.
units.displayText: Uranus turns to Penumbra, his ever-so-static countenance making his tone indistinguishable.

spans.text: Uranus turns to Penumbra, his ever-so-static countenance making his tone indistinguishable.

units.rawText: In honesty, I can understand the feeling... that life ends when duty ends.
units.displayText: In honesty, I can understand the feeling... that life ends when duty ends.

spans.text: In honesty, I can understand the feeling... that life ends when duty ends.

units.rawText: ...I as well.
units.displayText: ...I as well.

spans.text: ...I as well.

units.rawText: We are such as Dolls. To be used by humanity is the reason for our existence. Other than that, we have so very little.
units.displayText: We are such as Dolls. To be used by humanity is the reason for our existence. Other than that, we have so very little.

spans.text: We are such as Dolls. To be used by humanity is the reason for our existence. Other than that, we have so very little.

units.displayText: Penumbra casts his eyes downwards, an unpleasant piece of memory surfacing.

spans.text: Penumbra casts his eyes downwards, an unpleasant piece of memory surfacing.

units.rawText: And I am... one with so very little.
units.displayText: And I am... one with so very little.

spans.text: And I am... one with so very little.

units.rawText: Svarog Heavy Industries research facility, Omega-07 internal meeting.
units.displayText: Svarog Heavy Industries research facility, Omega-07 internal meeting.

spans.text: Svarog Heavy Industries research facility, Omega-07 internal meeting.

units.rawText: Is OpsTec to be retrieved?
units.displayText: Is OpsTec to be retrieved?

spans.text: Is OpsTec to be retrieved?

units.rawText: Yes, seeing as Hassan's fallen from power. If OpsTec remains at large as an experimental model for optical camouflage, the possibility of the technology leaking is very real.
units.displayText: Yes, seeing as Hassan's fallen from power. If OpsTec remains at large as an experimental model for optical camouflage, the possibility of the technology leaking is very real.

spans.text: Yes, seeing as Hassan's fallen from power. If OpsTec remains at large as an experimental model for optical camouflage, the possibility of the technology leaking is very real.

units.rawText: What meaning does retrieval have? The testing for the camouflage is at an end, and a test Doll like him has no usage in other fields.
units.displayText: What meaning does retrieval have? The testing for the camouflage is at an end, and a test Doll like him has no usage in other fields.

spans.text: What meaning does retrieval have? The testing for the camouflage is at an end, and a test Doll like him has no usage in other fields.

units.rawText: How pitiful. No possible usage as a C-Doll either after data deletion.
units.displayText: How pitiful. No possible usage as a C-Doll either after data deletion.

spans.text: How pitiful. No possible usage as a C-Doll either after data deletion.

units.rawText: With how clumsy that guy is, I can't imagine he even has the requisite knowledge for daily life. You think he stands a chance of integrating into human society? Odds are that he'd become some sort of terrorist threat to society...
units.displayText: With how clumsy that guy is, I can't imagine he even has the requisite knowledge for daily life. You think he stands a chance of integrating into human society? Odds are that he'd become some sort of terrorist threat to society...

spans.text: With how clumsy that guy is, I can't imagine he even has the requisite knowledge for daily life. You think he stands a chance of integrating into human society? Odds are that he'd become some sort of terrorist threat to society...

units.rawText: With the help of optical camouflage, Penumbra heard everything, hidden outside the meeting room window. A few days prior, he was brought to this research facility by Svarog researchers, and locked in solitary confinement. Not so different from his treatment under Hassan.
units.displayText: With the help of optical camouflage, Penumbra heard everything, hidden outside the meeting room window. A few days prior, he was brought to this research facility by Svarog researchers, and locked in solitary confinement. Not so different from his treatment under Hassan.

spans.text: With the help of optical camouflage, Penumbra heard everything, hidden outside the meeting room window. A few days prior, he was brought to this research facility by Svarog researchers, and locked in solitary confinement. Not so different from his treatment under Hassan.

units.rawText: While someone was examining his body, Penumbra knocked out the maintenance staff, and escaped using optical camouflage. Knowing that his memory would be cleared once again, he carefully hit the button on the archaic recorder.
units.displayText: While someone was examining his body, Penumbra knocked out the maintenance staff, and escaped using optical camouflage. Knowing that his memory would be cleared once again, he carefully hit the button on the archaic recorder.

spans.text: While someone was examining his body, Penumbra knocked out the maintenance staff, and escaped using optical camouflage. Knowing that his memory would be cleared once again, he carefully hit the button on the archaic recorder.

units.displayText: This conversation was recorded as such, playing over and over again.

spans.text: This conversation was recorded as such, playing over and over again.

units.rawText: Exactly like those parts of his, damaged on the battlefield, reminding him—the humans no longer have need of him, thus his existence was meaningless.
units.displayText: Exactly like those parts of his, damaged on the battlefield, reminding him—the humans no longer have need of him, thus his existence was meaningless.

spans.text: Exactly like those parts of his, damaged on the battlefield, reminding him—the humans no longer have need of him, thus his existence was meaningless.

units.displayText: The sudden presence of the guard in the conference room throws the venue into chaos, but it soon settles as Penumbra introduces himself to the situation.

spans.text: The sudden presence of the guard in the conference room throws the venue into chaos, but it soon settles as Penumbra introduces himself to the situation.

units.displayText: His memories shall be wiped again, as clean as can be.

units.rawText: Hah... a stray dog is a fitting description, no?
